parameters.content:
## US Commercial Permits & FMCSA Signals -> Live Domain SPF/DMARC/SSL & Tech-Stack Audit Chain (Dual Apify -> Slack + Sheets)

### How it works

This workflow runs each weekday at 8AM EST to collect US commercial contractor signals through an Apify actor, then derives candidate company domains from the results. It sends those domains through a second Apify audit to verify live websites and check SPF, DMARC, SSL, and related tech-stack signals. Verified domains are filtered and scored, with actionable prospects sent to Slack and all qualifying audit results appended to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger for the intended weekday cadence and confirm the workflow timezone is set to EST or the desired local timezone.
- Add valid Apify API credentials or tokens for both HTTP Request nodes and confirm the referenced Pipeforge actors and input payloads are correct.
- Configure Slack credentials and choose the target channel for hot prospect alerts.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the destination spreadsheet, sheet, and column mapping for verified domain audit rows.
- Review the IF node threshold and ensure the upstream audit returns the score and verification fields expected by the filter and branch logic.

### Customization

Adjust the Apify actor inputs, verified-website filter rules, and the actionable score threshold to match your target market. You can also change the Slack message format or Google Sheets columns to capture additional audit fields.

## Collect candidate signals

Starts the scheduled run, pulls US commercial GC/FMCSA-style signals from Apify, and converts the returned company data into candidate domains for audit.

## Verify and score domains

Runs the live-domain and SPF/DMARC/SSL audit, filters out non-live or unverified websites, and checks whether each remaining prospect meets the actionable score threshold.

## Alert and record results

Handles the final outputs from the scoring branch by posting hot prospect alerts to Slack and appending verified domain audit details to Google Sheets.
